$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFMX (AIP France, chart dated 2024-08-08): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Château-Arnoux-Saint-Auban

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: Heavy glider activity at the beginning and at the end of the afternoon Severe downdrafts with North and South-East wind.
Heavy ground after rainy periods and thaw.
Home based gliders allowed to land back with radio failure.
The dyke may cause water to be retained in the southern zone and potentially soggy zones.
NOV-JAN: movement area inspection not carried out.
Due to noise pollution, avoid overflying of the neighbouring built up areas and comply with published circuits.
Non-home based ACFT: LDG and TKOF must be conducted on axis 021°/201°; other axis may be used by home based ACFT.
If wind less than 2 m/s, use main axis 201°.

Paved acceleration mini strips are reserved for homebased aircraft: Bande / Strip Sud / South "Whisky": 350 x 7 m - 188° Bande / Strip Nord / North "Whisky": 300 x 7 m - 031° Bande / Strip Nord / North "Echo": 290 x 7 m - 013° Bande / Strip 230: 350 x 7 m - 226° Bande / Strip 240: 360 x 7 m - 237° Taxiing prohibited except on beaconed perimeter.
Phraseology used by home-based ACFT: Take off from acceleration strip: Take off announced specifying the strip used.
Ex: F-XX taking off from South "Whisky".
Landings: Due to the width of the manoeuvring area, the airfield is divided in two different zones, East (Echo) and West (Whisky), separated by the central axis (021°/201°).
Landing is announced specifying: The general orientation of the landing (North or South); The chosen sector (Echo or Whisky).
Ex: F-XX down wind for North "Whisky".
